platform.headline: One platform instead of
platform.body: A till here, a spreadsheet there, an accountant at month-end, orders on chat. TajirPoint replaces the patchwork — and the pieces talk to each other. One sale updates stock, the customer's balance, the ledger and the tax record in a single action.

till.now: Fast barcode checkout, split payments, shifts

register.now: Tamper-proof digital ledger, shared on WhatsApp

chat.now: A hosted online store and order inbox

offline.title: Sells straight through internet outages
offline.body: Connectivity drops; the counter doesn't. Sales queue locally on the device and sync back safely when the network returns — no duplicates, nothing lost.

accounting.title: Books that do themselves
accounting.body: A real double-entry ledger, auto-posted from every sale, purchase and payroll run. Clean books, zero journal entries.

inventory.title: Stock that tracks itself
inventory.body: Multi-warehouse, batch & expiry, serial/IMEI, unit conversion — carton to piece — with a full audit trail.

distribution.title: Van sales, door to door
distribution.body: Load a truck as a mobile warehouse, sell on route, reconcile cash, goods and fuel at day end.

storefront.title: A storefront, auto-generated
storefront.body: A hosted online store built from your own products — themes, your logo, your domain, online ordering.

security.title: Locked down by role
security.body: Owner, manager, cashier, driver — each sees only their screens. 2FA, API keys and a full audit log.

ledger.headline: A credit book, with a real ledger underneath
ledger.body: Most shops still track customer credit in a notebook. TajirPoint replaces it with a true double-entry ledger that still feels that simple — running balances, credit limits, statements, aging.

customer-ledgers.d: Every customer’s running balance updates instantly. Always exact, never out of sync.

credit-limits.d: Warn or block at sale time. Advances allocate cleanly against open invoices.

aging.d: 30 / 60 / 90+ day buckets. Statements shareable to WhatsApp in three languages.

supplier-ledgers.d: PO → GRN → invoice → payment. Returns, advances, allocations — one trail.

box.body: Everything below ships with every plan — not as an extension, not as a partner integration. The platform is the product.

sell.title: A POS that doesn’t blink
sell.body: Cart, barcode scan, hold orders, parked carts, shift open/close. Cash, card, cheque, wallet, split tenders.

inventory.title: Stock you can trust
inventory.body: Multi-warehouse with in-transit tracking. FIFO / moving average / actual cost. Unit conversions chain carton ↔ box ↔ piece.

sales.title: Quote → invoice → returns
sales.body: Quotations convert in one click. Multi-rule discount engine: time-based, customer-segment, BOGO, percentage, fixed.

purchases.title: PO to payment, one trail
purchases.body: POs → GRN → supplier invoice → payment. Returns with credit notes. Advances allocated against bills.

dispatch.title: Trip planning & POD
dispatch.body: Multi-stop trips, load/unload tracking, a driver app, proof-of-delivery capture, end-of-day reconciliation.

money.title: Ledger-grade money handling
money.body: Cheque lifecycle with bounce reversal, drawers and petty cash with variance, bank statement import and reconciliation.

devices.body: One product, every device — browser, Windows desktop and Android, all from one codebase, all sharing one inventory and one ledger. Native receipt printing, barcode scanning and Bluetooth.

extensions.headline: Start lean.
extensions.body: The core does the common work. 31 installable extensions switch on what your business needs — restaurant floor plans, payment gateways, courier booking, e-commerce sync — and the interface only shows what's turned on.

import.title: Import your products
import.body: Bulk import from CSV or Excel — Shopify and WooCommerce exports are detected automatically.

install.title: Install your extensions
install.body: Pick from 31 add-ons. The interface only shows what you switch on.

connect.title: Connect your hardware
connect.body: Receipt printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers — or just a phone camera.

sell.title: Start selling
sell.body: Web, desktop or Android. Online or offline. Books post themselves.

verticals.headline: Six industries. One system that fits each.

pricing.headline: One price. Every module.
pricing.body: No per-module upsells, no transaction fees. Pay per branch. Billing in PKR, AED and SAR.
pricing.note: Indicative pricing — confirmed at checkout in your billing currency.

offline.q: Does it really keep selling without internet?
offline.a: Yes. Sales queue locally on the device and sync back safely when the connection returns — no duplicate or lost sales. Power and connectivity problems never stop the counter.

accountant.q: Do I need an accountant to use the accounting?
accountant.a: No. Every sale, purchase, payment, expense and payroll run posts to a real double-entry general ledger automatically. You never touch a journal entry; your accountant gets clean books.

platforms.q: What platforms does it run on?
platforms.a: Web (any browser), a Windows desktop app, and Android — all from one codebase, so features land everywhere at once. iOS is coming soon. Thermal printers, barcode scanners and cash drawers are supported.

languages.a: English, Urdu and Arabic are first-class languages with full right-to-left layout and instant in-app switching.

extensions.a: Extensions are installed per shop and switch on extra capability — restaurant tools, payment gateways, courier booking, e-commerce sync. The interface only shows what’s turned on, so a small store never sees screens it doesn’t need.

migrate.q: Can I migrate from Shopify or WooCommerce?
migrate.a: Yes — bulk import auto-detects Shopify and WooCommerce exports, and two-way sync extensions keep products, stock and orders aligned if you keep selling there.

cta.body: 14 days free. Every module included. No card required.
